---
title: "TACE PSM"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(MatchIt)
library(cobalt)
library(readr)

# Load your data
df_tace_sys <- read_csv("df_tace_sys.csv")

# Run MatchIt with ratio matching
m.out <- matchit(
  sequence_group ~ AGE + SEX + RACE 
    + INSURANCE_STATUS
    + Charlson_Deyo_Score + HISTOLOGY + COMBINED_STAGE_GROUP
    + YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS + Surgery + Radiation_Therapy,
  data = df_tace_sys,
  method = "nearest",
  ratio = 4,
  caliper = 0.2
)

# Print standardized summary
summary(m.out, standardize = TRUE)
```

```{r}
love.plot(m.out, 
          binary = "std", 
          thresholds = c(m = .1),
          var.order = "unadjusted", 
          abs = TRUE)
```
```{r}
matched_tace_sys <- match.data(m.out)
write_csv(matched_tace_sys, "matched_tace_sys.csv")
```
